name: While Digital AI Reviews for Google Business
author: While Digital

sections.description:
While Digital AI Reviews for Google Business helps you display Google Business reviews and AI-powered summaries anywhere on your WordPress site.

Features include:

  • Connect a Google Business Profile using a Google Maps URL or business name
  • Display reviews with a shortcode or Elementor widget
  • Show AI-powered review summaries alongside customer feedback
  • Choose from responsive layouts including Slider, Carousel, Grid, Masonry, List, Badge, Testimonial, and Floating
  • Filter reviews by rating, control the review count, and choose the display order
  • Customize colors, typography, cards, buttons, and carousel controls with the visual Custom Design editor
  • Automatically refresh saved review data with WP-Cron

External Services

This plugin relies on external services to fetch business information, reviews, business photos, and AI summaries:

  1. While Digital API Proxy (Cloudflare Worker by While Digital)

* Purpose: Acts as a secure server-side API proxy to connect with Google Places API and AI summary generation without exposing API credentials.
* What Data is Sent: Business search queries, Place IDs, location coordinates (latitude/longitude), photo references, and stored review text snippets (for AI summary generation).
* When Data is Sent: Sent via server-to-server HTTP POST requests when an administrator searches for a business, creates or manually refreshes a widget, or during scheduled background WP-Cron refreshes every 10 to 20 days.
* Service Links:
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– Cloudflare Infrastructure Terms
– Cloudflare Privacy Policy

  1. Google Places API (Google LLC)

* Purpose: Provides official Google Business Profile details, ratings, total review counts, business photos, and customer reviews (proxied through the While Digital API Proxy).
* What Data is Sent: Business search terms, Place IDs, and location biases via server-side API requests.
* When Data is Sent: Triggered during widget creation, manual refresh, or periodic background WP-Cron sync.
* Service Links:
– Google Terms of Service
– Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. You will be redirected to the setup wizard automatically
  4. Connect your Google Business Profile in the setup wizard
sections.faq:
Is my API key secure?

Yes. API credentials are handled by the While Digital API Proxy and are never sent to the browser or exposed in page source.

How many reviews can I show?

Google Places API returns up to 5 reviews per request. We fetch from two sort orders
to get up to 10 unique reviews. Over time, as reviews refresh, more accumulate in your database.

How often are reviews updated?

Reviews are automatically refreshed every 10 days via WordPress Cron.
